notes.title: Comedy Quest 2.0 Live
notes.content:
First big update since It's completions.

Many little fixes have been added such as 

* Winsetup can now be launched for better chance of it working

* Added acwin.exe that should help with people experiencing trouble with the mouse.

* Fixed crashing after walking off stage on the second gig. 

* I've tried to turn down the clapping sound effect to protect those with headphones.

* Added computer option in the kids appartment.

* Clearer end credits and blooper beeps on audio.

* fixed easter egg given unlimited score.

Still to come achievements. Still having trouble getting them to work but will upload as soon I can.

Sorry for the long wait. Thanks for playing Comedy Quest.
-Trav Nash

notes.title: Update still to come.
notes.content:
I've been slowly working on the next update for Comedy Quest on Steam. 
I'm trying to fix a lot of things at once because Adventure Game Studio updates normally break the save games.

 So far I think I've fixed.

* the Easter egg giving ever lasting points.
* few minor problems with gigs not finishing.
* I think I fixed the mouse issue people are experiencing.
* Added some new dialogue in some places.

I still need to work out to get get Steam Achievements to work but as soon as I have I will release the update.

Sorry for the wait.

any suggestions for anything else I am open to listen to.
